details:
Description

I'm playing in a world (FISH! by Godfall) where persistence data may change or update often. Sometimes, when I leave or rejoin the world, a message appears telling me to wait while world data is being transmitted with a number of bunches remaining. Nothing happens during this time for 20-30 seconds. The amount of bunches doesn't decrease and when I'm back to the FISH! world, all or part of my progress gets lost which becomes very frustrating. If I exit VRChat instead, the message doesn't show up and it's as if nothing gets transfered at all.

Reproduction Steps

Play FISH! for a while, catching or selling a lot of fish for a good amount of time, then change world or rejoin the world and the issue may occur.

Details

- Category: Other

- Frequency: Sometimes
